Camila — short answers below, copying Marcus for any SE/ops notes.

1) Report availability / redaction:
- We have the full pentest report from the external vendor dated 2026-04-28 (scope: Hosted API endpoints, auth flows, telemetry ingestion pipeline).
- For external customers we provide: (a) an executive summary PDF and (b) a customer-specific full report that is redacted for any customer data (if the vendor included customer-specific examples). In this case the vendor found a low-severity credential-exposure vector that referenced a dev test account — we'll redact identifiers.

2) Approved transfer methods:
- Preferred: Secure Box link with company SSO access (Box enterprise link) + link expiry and 'require password' enabled. Password delivered out-of-band (SMS or phone).
- Alternate: Time-limited presigned S3 URL (expires 7 days) — only if customer accepts URL and we log accesses.
- Last resort: Encrypted ZIP (AES-256) uploaded to our secure file share; password exchanged via verified phone or Signal.

We do NOT send full reports over regular email, even if zipped. Also we need to record the transfer in our compliance ticket.

3) Paperwork: Standard Customer NDA is not required for published Redwood assessment artifacts, but if BrightLane prefers, we can execute a short mutual NDA or addenda. If they need SOC2 evidence beyond the report (control descriptions), we can coordinate through the GRC portal (link below).

ETA: I can prepare the redacted customer copy and a short cover memo in ~4 business hours. Marcus: can you stage the Box link and set expiry + password?

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

What we'll share (attachments/stubs below):
- Executive summary (PDF) — attached.
- Full penetration test report (redacted) — encrypted and uploaded to a secure Box folder; link below will be active for 7 days.

Secure delivery plan:

- Access controls: requires BrightLane SSO or a limited guest link.
- Password: we will send a one-time password via SMS to the number you provided (+1 415 555 0192) or via your security inbox if you prefer email out-of-band. Please confirm your preference.
- Audit logging: access will be recorded in our compliance ticket and we can provide an access report on request.

Attachments (PDF stub) included with this email:
- redwood-2026-05-pt-summary.pdf (executive summary)

If you require the report via presigned S3 instead, tell me and we'll generate the link (7-day expiry) and include the same out-of-band password. If you'd rather receive an encrypted ZIP, we can do that too — password delivered via confirmed phone/SMS.

Next step: please confirm (A) preferred transfer method (Box / S3 / encrypted ZIP) and (B) how you'd like to receive the password (SMS to +1 415 555 0192 or Security mailbox). Once you confirm, we'll share the redacted full report and cover memo within a few hours.

Thanks — Camila
